structure: Part 1, "Notification list and its row actions", read every file of src/server/app/sets/high-risk-plants/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/ in full (page.js 5 lines, controller.js 184, template.njk 133, notification-helper.js 177, notification-helper.test.js 272, dashboard.fit.spec.js 334, late-tag.test.js 31, controller.test.js 585, copy/copy.en.js 65, copy/copy.cy.js 66, copy/copy.test.js 82, view-model/sort-options.js 18, view-model/row/index.js 35, view-model/row/actions.js 74, view-model/row/index.test.js 71) and journeys/linear/flow/notification-action-slugs.js. For context it also read journeys/linear/features/review/lateness.js (part 10's), src/server/app/shared/layout.njk, shared/kit.js and shared/paging.js (part 13's), plus three files its slice points at but does not claim in their own right: shared/paths.js (the route and link paths the list builds), sets/high-risk-plants/set.js (SET_BASE '/high-risk-plants') and journeys/linear/flow/section-captions/ (the caption the list renders), and services/persistence/records/stub/marshal/list-item.js and stub/list-query.js, which are the source of the list row the view model reshapes and of its 20-row page. The part covers the list page served at the set root (caption, H1, intro, guidance sentence that never renders, start button, Your notifications heading, keyword search, results label, sort control, summary-card rows in order, status and Late tags, link and posting actions, empty state, pagination, the deleted and amend-refused banners), the four routes the feature owns (GET '/', POST /notifications, GET /start, POST /notifications/{journeyId}/amend), every copy key of the English and Welsh pair verbatim, the 16 tests of dashboard.fit.spec.js one by one, the two late-tag unit cases, and notification-helper.js, view-model/row/index.js and view-model/sort-options.js as mechanism claims. It stops at the task-list hub (part 2), the delete and cancel-amend confirmation pages the row actions link to (their own parts), and the lateness rule itself (part 10).

claims.statement: The notification list is the page served at the set root, /high-risk-plants, and a signed-in trader lands on it as the service's home page.
claims.note: dashboardRoutePath() is '/' (shared/paths.js:9) and the set mounts at SET_BASE = '/high-risk-plants' (set.js), so the served path is /high-risk-plants. The feature's page descriptor carries slug ''.

claims.statement: The list page is marked as still exploring, so the service shows its page-maturity banner above the page.
claims.note: The route passes the page descriptor through kit.pageRouteOptions, and the shared layout includes "page-maturity/banner.njk" on every page, which reads that maturity. The banner's own copy is outside this part.

claims.note: The caption value comes from the flow's section captions, where the dashboard page sits in a section whose English name is 'Dashboard' (another part owns that file). controller.test.js:118 pins that the view carries a caption.

You will answer a short set of questions about the consignment, then submit your notification."
